waypoints.name: Blue Lake Trailhead
waypoints.directions: Drive SR-20 to the Blue Lake Trailhead on the south side of the highway between mileposts 161 and 162, about a mile west of Washington Pass, at roughly 5,200 ft. A Northwest Forest Pass is required. The highway over the pass is closed in winter.

waypoints.name: Concord Tower summit
waypoints.directions: Hike the Blue Lake Trail and take the climbers' path toward the Beckey Gully. As you reach Concord Tower's west face, head uphill staying close to the wall to the base, about 25 ft left of a large corner and well left of the South Face routes, then climb six pitches to the summit.
